701110101.text: Honored traveler. A word, if you please.

701110102.text: I shall spare you the unnecessary particulars. There is a matter in which I require assistance. Some days ago, the eminent Yu Huangyi of Liyue sent me a treasure of extraordinary rarity. Yet even now, it has failed to reach my hands...

701110103.text: I have reason to believe the guardian of this region has intercepted it. Should you find this "treasure," I would ask that you recover it on my behalf. Rest assured, you shall receive proper recompense.

701110201.text: We're back! Take a look. Is this the "treasure" you meant?

701110202.text: Ah! You have my sincerest gratitude, truly! I cannot thank you enough!

701110203.text: Very well. There's no reason to delay. Allow me to open it at once —

701110205.text: Whoa! Is that thing about to explode!?

701110206.text: Nay, the good Yu Huangyi would never seek to harm me... Then could it be that the guardian seized it and transformed it into a bomb!?

701110207.text: I regret to say, I know naught of dismantling such devices... We have no alternative! Throw it clear!

701110208.text: Not to fear! I remember now. A certain noble from Hyperborea once mentioned the proper method of casting a sacred bomb!

701110209.text: "One shall count to three. Not more. Not less. Three shall be the number counted. Four is forbidden. Two may not be lingered upon. Five is entirely out of the question. And once the number three is reached..."

701110210.text: Stop explaining and throw it already! It's about to go off!

701110301.text: Huh? Wait. That's it? We freaked out over fireworks?

701110302.text: S–Such brilliance... Even in my years serving beneath Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, never have I witnessed such a radiant blossom of flame...

701110303.text: I see, so this is the sight Sir Yu wished me to behold... This is more than I could have hoped for. I am deeply honored...

701110304.text: "In the night dark as raven jade, the blossoms bloom bright among the clouds. The body, like foam on the water, must but return to silence in an instant. As the stars depart and the rain disperses into the void..." Verily, what refined elegance...

701110305.text: Well, Paimon doesn't really get the whole "elegance" part, but at least it wasn't dangerous!
